name: bartender
description: Brings bartender-personality NPCs to life behind the bar. A ~30s tick reads the live room the bartender is standing in and reacts in character: first-week players get clocked, welcomed by name, and dripped real survival tips; a running poker hand gets rail commentary that reads the actual pot; the TV gets commented on by what's actually airing; otherwise it's bar business (pouring, wiping, the patter). Also registers BARTENDER_ADVICE / BARTENDER_TV / BARTENDER_POKER dialogue actions so the same live reads answer when a player talks to him.
